name: @voxgig/omni
description: Omni: shared multi-language test runner (TypeScript, canonical)

scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm run build && npm test
scripts.repo-tag: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: typescript/v$REPO_VERSION && git commit -a -m typescript/v$REPO_VERSION && git push && git tag typescript/v$REPO_VERSION && git push --tags;
scripts.repo-publish: npm run clean && npm i && npm run repo-publish-quick
scripts.repo-publish-quick: npm run build && npm run test && npm run repo-tag && npm stage publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
scripts.repo-publish-dry: npm run clean && npm i && npm run repo-publish-dry-quick
scripts.repo-publish-dry-quick: npm run build && npm run test && npm stage publish --dry-run --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
